limitations: One held-out split and one candidate do not establish statistical robustness, causal effect, generalization, or reproduction of the Cortez et al. SVM.
The product campaign plan revision was recorded with the Stop decision after seeing both Runs; the batch acceptance scope was fixed earlier, but the product plan is not a preregistration.
Campaign Stop prevents further campaign effects; a separate WorkingGrant still has one unused development submission until its fixed expiry. Revoking it would invalidate completed bindings.
The previous Table 1 descriptive-statistics Run has a different contract and is excluded from this predictive comparison.
No product code, frontend layout, or public export was changed in this batch.

Although train/test indices are disjoint, 91 of 320 test rows duplicate complete training rows. This fixed split is not duplicate-group-disjoint and cannot support a claim of independent-sample generalization.
Pi read only the first 300 bytes of split.json; the fixed Docker source snapshots and independent audit cover all indices.
